uncertain.item: 14 basic Forest in maindeck lands column
uncertain.reason: Screenshot is vertically truncated: the lands column header reads 17, but only 9 rows render before the image cuts off (Windswept Heath, Verdant Catacombs, Prismatic Vista, and 6 Forest). The remaining 8 rows are not visible in the image at all. Inferred to be 14 Forest total (17 lands minus the 3 visible non-basic fetches), based on the header count and the fact that no other non-basic card is missing from the picks-list reconciliation. If the header count itself were misread, this number would be wrong; the 6 visibly-confirmed Forest are certain, the other 8 are inferred.
